Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.springboot.keyvalue

Class InMemoryKeyValueStore

java.lang.Object
eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.springboot.keyvalue.InMemoryKeyValueStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
KeyValueStore
public class InMemoryKeyValueStore extends Object implements KeyValueStore
A table in the memory of the application, for local runs and tests: the items are lost when it stops, and every instance has its own. Conditional writes are atomic within the instance.

    • update

      public boolean update(KeyValueStore.Key key, Map<String,Object> set, Map<String,Object> expected)
      Description copied from interface: KeyValueStore
      Changes attributes of an existing item if its attributes have the expected values (optimistic concurrency). Attributes not named in set stay as they are.
      Specified by:
      update in interface KeyValueStore
      Parameters:
      key - the key
      set - the attributes to set; a null value removes the attribute
      expected - the values the attributes must have; a null value means the attribute must be absent. Empty: the item must only exist
      Returns:
      true if the item was changed, false if there is no such item or an attribute does not have the expected value

    • query

      public KeyValueStore.Page query(String partition, String sortKeyPrefix, int limit, String pageToken)
      Description copied from interface: KeyValueStore
      Reads a page of the items of a partition whose sort keys start with a prefix, in the order of their sort keys.
      Specified by:
      query in interface KeyValueStore
      Parameters:
      partition - the partition key
      sortKeyPrefix - the prefix of the sort keys, "" for all items of the partition
      limit - the maximum number of items of the page, 1 to 1000
      pageToken - the KeyValueStore.Page.nextPageToken() of the previous page, or null for the first page
      Returns:
      the page; it may have fewer items than the limit even if more follow
